## permissionedCoinbaseTokens variable

The registry of all known permissioned wrapped tokens that require a Coinbase attestation. All permissioned Coinbase tokens are considered PermissionedERC20Wrapper and automatically added to the permissionedWrapperTokens registry.

**Signature:**

```typescript
permissionedCoinbaseTokens: Record<number, Set<`0x${string}`>>
```
